'''Luke Ganser''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Montana State Championship]] on 28 April 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Biker ROps]], according to Jeremy LaMere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2187">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-billings-mt-4-28-2001-statesd2187/ billings-mt-4-28-2001-states], DeckTech (Jeremy "jerome" LaMere, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-billings-mt-4-28-2001-statesd2187/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
